newsitem.title: UK: Minor fire put out in Chunnel - UK police.
newsitem.headline: Minor fire put out in Chunnel - UK police.

text.p: A minor fire broke out on Wednesday near the site of last week's blaze in the Channel Tunnel operated by Anglo-French Eurotunnel but was quickly extinguished, British police said.
Police in the southeastern county of Kent said the fire was apparently sparked by welding work during repairs.
There were no immediate reports of injuries or damage, Kent police said.
"There was an extremely minor fire in the same site as the previous fire. From what I understand, Eurotunnel had their own fire personnel there, so they dealt with it," a Kent police spokesman said.
A Eurotunnel spokesman was not immediately available for comment.
The fire came as the company sought to reassure the public about the safety of the Tunnel after last week's fire, which injured 34 people and halted most rail services between France and Britain.
